sources.provenance: Karnataka WRD basin decomposition (KWRIS), sub-basin C2 polygon carried over from the cauvery-ka overview ingest. Every other layer here is clipped to it, so the atlas covers the Karnataka portion of the Kabini only - the Wayanad (Kerala) headwaters are out of scope.

India-WRIS watershed polygons (Watersheds_in_CauveryBasin), via Paani Earth's Cauvery hydrology GeoPackage (Aug 2026), clipped to the KWRIS C2 boundary: the nine watersheds that each hold at least 0.2% of the sub-basin, together 99.6% of it. India-WRIS publishes these with codes (wsconc) and no names, so the code is the label; areaKm2 is the watershed's full area as published, before the clip.

India-WRIS named river centrelines (Kabini ~155 km in-basin, Gundal ~83 km), via Paani Earth's Cauvery hydrology GeoPackage (Aug 2026), clipped to the C2 boundary. Replaces the 11 unnamed KWRIS C2 stream segments the first build carried; the Nugu, Taraka and the other tributaries are in the drainage layer, which the partner package names but does not publish as river centrelines.

India-WRIS stream network for the Kabini (Kabini_Drainage, 19,615 segments basin-wide), via Paani Earth's Cauvery hydrology GeoPackage (Aug 2026); clipped to the C2 boundary and simplified to ~11 m. Names are the source's rivname where it carries one - most first- and second-order segments are unnamed.
India-WRIS major waterbodies, via Paani Earth's Cauvery hydrology GeoPackage (Aug 2026); the five inside the C2 boundary.
Karnataka GIS minor-irrigation tank inventory (KGIS TIS), via Paani Earth's Cauvery hydrology GeoPackage (Aug 2026); the 653 tanks inside the C2 boundary.

CPCB's 2025 polluted stretch - 'River Kabini from Saragur village D/S to water supply intake point to Narasipura town', Priority V (Polluted River Stretches for Restoration of Water Quality 2025, CPCB, October 2025, p.15; max BOD 6 mg/L, p.77). Geometry digitised by Paani Earth (PRS_Stretches_Since_1993.gpkg, Aug 2026); length is her delivered distance attribute, 104.34 km. The 2018 and 2020 stretch lines in the same package are NOT ingested: KSPCB's own action plan puts that stretch at about 9 km and the delivered geometry maps only ~3 km of it, so the earlier epochs are reported in prs.json from the documents rather than drawn short.
KIADB industrial areas (KGIS), via Paani Earth Cauvery GIS package (Aug 2026); features intersecting the Kabini boundary.
KIADB industrial area points (KGIS), via Paani Earth Cauvery GIS package (Aug 2026); features intersecting the Kabini boundary.
Quarry polygons digitised from OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), via Paani Earth Cauvery GIS package (Aug 2026); features intersecting the Kabini boundary.
KGIS notified forest boundaries, via Paani Earth Cauvery GIS package (Aug 2026); features intersecting the Kabini boundary.
KGIS protected area boundaries (KFDC), via Paani Earth Cauvery GIS package (Aug 2026); features intersecting the Kabini boundary.
India-WRIS irrigation command areas, via Paani Earth Cauvery GIS package (Aug 2026); features intersecting the Kabini boundary.

India-WRIS National Register of Large Dams extract dated 14 April 2026, via Paani Earth's Cauvery hydrology GeoPackage (Aug 2026); the eight dams inside the Kabini boundary. Replaces the older CWC MLRD list the first build used - the two registers disagree on completion year for four minor tanks (Hebballa 1972 here vs 1965; Kamarahalli 1962 vs 1967; Kalikatte 1965 vs 1968; Karimuddenahalli 1973 vs 1972); the newer, dated register is the one shown.

India-WRIS barrage/weir/anicut register extract dated 14 April 2026, via Paani Earth's Cauvery hydrology GeoPackage (Aug 2026); the two anicuts inside the Kabini boundary (Hullhalli on the Kabini, Halsur on the Nugu).
CWC hydrological observation sites, via Paani Earth Cauvery GIS package (Aug 2026). hasReadings + packs are attached by scripts/build_basin_flow_readings.py from India-WRIS pulls.
District polygons (KGIS via Paani Earth's Admin GeoPackage) intersected with the KWRIS C2 boundary; severity from each district DEP's own sewage-gap figures (see gaps.json).
CPCB NWMP monitoring stations (WRIS station registry), via Paani Earth Cauvery GIS package (Aug 2026); stations within the Kabini boundary.
Karnataka district boundaries (KGIS), via Paani Earth's Admin GeoPackage (Aug 2026), clipped to the C2 boundary.
Karnataka taluk (subdistrict) boundaries (KGIS), via Paani Earth's Admin GeoPackage (Aug 2026), clipped to the C2 boundary.
Karnataka urban local body boundaries (KGIS Towns in the Cauvery basin), via Paani Earth's Admin GeoPackage (Aug 2026), clipped to the C2 boundary.
